name: human-review
description: Review and edit agent-generated files and localhost pages in the browser, then send the whole batch back to your agent.

interface.longDescription: Human Review provides focused skills for ordinary page review, planning-document review, structured LOA composition, and persistent project Notepad capture. Each workflow uses the existing Human Review browser or offline artifact runtime, while the original human-review skill remains available for backwards compatibility.
capabilities: Visually review HTML, Markdown, and localhost pages
Edit content directly and send comments to your agent
Review plans and structured Lists of Actions offline
Track unfinished project notes, cross-project tool bug reports, linked fixes, and delivered handoffs
defaultPrompt: ordinary-review: Review this HTML, Markdown, or localhost page and apply my browser feedback.
planning-review: Turn this plan, spec, PRD, or roadmap into an editable Human Review artifact.
loa-review: Turn this task or LOA into a reviewable action list with plugin and skill references.
human-review-notepad: Check project Issue Inbox and handoffs first, resolve actionable owner reports before new work, verify fixes, and close reports with their original IDs.
